scope: analysis and generated package inputs only; no CUE/BIN mutation

classification.storage_axis: master_text.region: slotNN -> scene.slotNN; other regions -> shared.<region>
classification.strict_core_definition: intersection of Hangul used by all four core renderer families
classification.limitation: Static CSV evidence does not prove runtime field/tower ownership for every row. Storage module and renderer family remain separate until Z8 relocation.

font_profile.placement: centre native ink in the 12x12 cell; an 8x8 glyph starts at x=2,y=2
font_profile.bit_order: two bytes per row, MSB first

code_map.fallback: non-Hangul double-byte codes use BIOS EX_GETFNT

next_gate: Z8 must bind each generated package to a proven loader-owned extension and relocate text without relying on cross-family RAM.
